citations.claim: Total energy at first violating step exceeds allowed bound with no controller work
Body moving upward after floor bounce with higher speed/energy than physically consistent with e=1 drop

counterfactual.change: Changed restitution e from 1.0 to 0.9 only; dissipative bounce removes net energy gain so bound holds

explanation: Single elastic (e=1) ball dropped from rest gains net mechanical energy across floor bounce(s) with no controller work. Positional correction / impulse with large dt (~0.029, 6-8 substeps) injects energy on contact (restitution plus depenetration adds upward velocity), so final energy 389.38 exceeds E0 plus 10%+5J tolerance (limit 389.35).
vision_note: A single blue ball falls to the floor and makes contact around steps 169-170, then is seen just above the floor in step 171 after the bounce. No other bodies, walls, controller or waypoints are visible in the strip.
